**Challenge:** Our conveyor frames crack at the weld joints after roughly 18 months of operation in chilled environments; we've replaced 14 assemblies under warranty this year and we can't reproduce the failure in our workshop because we test at room temperature.

## Why this pair
Shared ground with the company: crack, joints, environments, under. Bojan Erić works on Mechanical Engineering and Materials Science and Structural Integrity, and the company's robotics and industrial automation roadmap needs exactly that.

## What we would do together
A 12-month joint project: Our conveyor frames crack at the weld joints after roughly 18 months of operation in chilled environments; we've replaced 14 assemblies under warranty this year and we can't reproduce the failure in our workshop because we test at room temperature. The company brings we have no dedicated r&d department; technical development happens informally through project work, led by our chief engineer and two senior automation engineers who allocate time between live projects and improvement work. The faculty brings fatigue crack growth, fracture mechanics, welded steel joints.

## Industrial PhD option
If the results hold, the work becomes an industrial PhD topic supervised by Bojan Erić (Department of Mechanical Engineering (Machine Design and Mechanics)) and an engineer from AutomVoj a.d..

## Risks
The pairing depends on data access the company has not yet committed. No structural risk identified.

**Challenge:** Our PLC programs for different customers are each a custom spaghetti of ladder logic; when we want to push a safety patch we have to touch 38 separate codebases and it takes three engineers two full weeks.

## Why this pair
Shared ground with the company: plc, during, structured, code. Veljko Pantelić works on Software Engineering and Industrial Automation, and the company's robotics and industrial automation roadmap needs exactly that.

A 12-month joint project: Our PLC programs for different customers are each a custom spaghetti of ladder logic; when we want to push a safety patch we have to touch 38 separate codebases and it takes three engineers two full weeks. The company brings we have no dedicated r&d department; technical development happens informally through project work, led by our chief engineer and two senior automation engineers who allocate time between live projects and improvement work.
